high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Investopedia titled "Nvidia Earnings Live: Sales Surge Amid AI Boom, CEO Huang Expects Demand to Accelerate; Stock Jumps Nearly 5%." The article is authored by Stephen Wisnefski and was updated on May 28, 2025, at 8:17 PM EDT. The main focus of the image is a photograph of Jensen Huang, the CEO of Nvidia, speaking at an event in March. He is standing on stage with a confident posture, gesturing towards a display of server hardware. The background features large server racks illuminated
